our_interpretation: The forecast concerns numerous substantive public questions about both possible insider trading and corruption connected to reinstatement.

criteria.support_condition: Dated independent records establish broad and varied public questioning about both insider trading and corruption surrounding reinstatement.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A definitive record would need to foreclose the predicted questioning. A limited early record or rejection of the underlying allegations does not contradict a deadline-free forecast of questions.
